chunks: What al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Ibn Muskān, from al-Ḥalabī, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about performing Salat al-Layl and al-Witr at the beginning of the night while traveling, if I feared the cold or there was an illness. He said: There is no harm; I do so when I fear that.

key_terms.أَوَّلِ اللَّيْلِ: the beginning part of the night, earlier than its usual preferred time
key_terms.الْبَرْدَ: cold weather causing hardship or concern
key_terms.الْوِتْرِ: the witr prayer, the final unit of the night prayer
key_terms.صَلَاةِ اللَّيْلِ: the night prayer performed as a recommended act of worship
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem or legal objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform Salat al-Layl and al-Witr early in the night during travel due to cold or illness?
ai.summary: This hadith states that performing Salat al-Layl and al-Witr at the beginning of the night while traveling is permissible when there is fear of cold or illness. It indicates a practical legal concession in worship under difficult circumstances, affirmed by the Imam’s own practice.
